uni:draw.title: Draw
uni:draw.description: Take one or more cards from the [k=uni:draw_pile]draw pile[/k] into your hand.

uni:skip.title: Skip
uni:skip.description: Causes the next player in [k=uni:turn]turn[/k] order to lose their turn.

uni:reverse.title: Reverse
uni:reverse.description: Reverses the direction of play. In a 2-player match, acts as a [k=uni:skip]skip[/k].

uni:wild.title: Wild
uni:wild.description: Can be played on any card. The player chooses the active [k=uni:color]color[/k].

uni:turn.title: Turn
uni:turn.description: A player's opportunity to [k=uni:play]play[/k] a valid card or [k=uni:draw]draw[/k].

uni:color.title: Color
uni:color.description: The active suit (Red, Blue, Green, Yellow) that determines valid plays.

uni:draw_pile.title: Draw Pile
uni:draw_pile.description: The central deck where players [k=uni:draw]draw[/k] cards when unable or choosing not to play.

uni:discard_pile.title: Discard Pile
uni:discard_pile.description: The pile where played cards are placed face-up.

uni:play.title: Play
uni:play.description: Place a matching card from your hand onto the [k=uni:discard_pile]discard pile[/k].

uni:seven_zero.title: 7-0 Rule
uni:seven_zero.description: Playing a 7 allows swapping hands with any player. Playing a 0 rotates all hands in [k=uni:turn]turn[/k] direction.

uni:draw_stacking.title: Draw Stacking
uni:draw_stacking.description: Stack +2 or +4 cards to pass the accumulated [k=uni:draw]draw[/k] penalty to the next player.

uni:force_play.title: Force Play
uni:force_play.description: When drawing a playable card from the deck, you must play it immediately.

uni:jump_in.title: Jump-In
uni:jump_in.description: Play out of turn if you have the exact identical card (same color and value) as the top card.

uni:progressive.title: Progressive
uni:progressive.description: Draw from the deck until you find a playable card, then choose whether to play it or keep it.

uni:race.title: Race
uni:race.description: The first players to empty their hand win. The match ends once enough have finished, and everyone else loses.
